You are auditing part of an "Agentic Design Workflow" repo at /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/Zimmermann-Handover — a client design/handover project for "Zimmermann" (fashion retail website redesign, component prefix "zimm", target stacks web+react). This is a READ-ONLY audit — do not modify any files.

Background on the folders you're checking:
- `02-design/specs/{components,screens,flows,templates}/`: one markdown spec file per design item, designer-owned, following a two-layer model (a design layer with tokens/variants/states/behaviour/a11y/prototype-link, and a platform layer added later by developers).
- `02-design/prototypes/{interactions,flows,tokens,animations,templates}/[name]/`: interactive HTML/CSS/JS prototypes. Each `[name]/` folder has `index.html`, an `intent.md` with YAML frontmatter (`spec:` — relative path to the spec it feeds, under `02-design/specs/; `stack:`; `stage:`; optional `viewer-label`, `viewer-group`, `viewer-canvas`), and `assets/styles.css`. `_platform/` is shared reference CSS, not a prototype — ignore it.
- `02-design/prototypes/INDEX.md`: a prototype registry, meant to be kept in sync by the `/add-to-viewer` skill whenever a prototype is registered.
- `02-design/viewer/viewer.config.js`: has a `variants` array that should list every prototype registered for the client-facing viewer.
- `02-design/catalog/index.html`: a component catalog that reads the contract at `02-design/library/contract/zimm-contract.js` dynamically to render library components.
- The full 8 library elements are: add-to-wishlist, button, footer, icon, logo, nav-item, navigation, product-card (in `02-design/library/elements/`, for cross-reference only — do not audit their internals, another agent is covering that).

Your job:

1. Enumerate every actual spec file under `02-design/specs/` (skip `.gitkeep`-only empty dirs) and every actual prototype folder under `02-design/prototypes/` (skip `_platform` and empty dirs).
2. Read `02-design/specs/components/footer.md` and `navigation.md`, and `02-design/specs/templates/template-main-large-screen.md`. Check the prototype folder `02-design/prototypes/templates/main-large-screen/intent.md`: does its `spec:` frontmatter path actually resolve to an existing file? Do the specs reference a prototype link that resolves to a real prototype, or reference one that doesn't exist?
3. Read `02-design/prototypes/INDEX.md` and the `variants` array inside `02-design/viewer/viewer.config.js`. Cross-check against the actual prototype folders found in step 1: is every real prototype folder represented in INDEX.md and/or viewer.config.js variants? Is variants empty despite prototypes existing on disk (meaning `/add-to-viewer` was never run for them)? List every mismatch by name.
4. Of the 8 library elements listed above, state which have a spec file under `specs/components/` and which don't — this is a coverage gap to report factually, not something to fix.
5. Skim `02-design/catalog/index.html` and `02-design/viewer/index.html` for obvious broken references — e.g. a hardcoded contract path, prefix, or config filename that doesn't match the real files (contract is at `02-design/library/contract/zimm-contract.js`, prefix is "zimm").

Report back in under 500 words: a findings list grouped as "Spec coverage gaps", "Prototype/viewer registry mismatches", and "Catalog/viewer wiring issues", each item as `path — one-sentence description`. State plainly if a section had no issues. Do not propose or apply fixes, this is audit only.

    .pv-overview-title {

    .pv-overview-body {

    .pv-overview-body h1,

    .pv-home-cards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .pv-home-card {

      gap: 16px;

                  background var(--pv-dur) var(--pv-ease);

    .pv-home-card:not(:last-child) { margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .pv-home-card:hover { border-color: #ffffff; background: var(--pv-surface); }
    .pv-home-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pv-link); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .pv-home-card-main {

    .pv-home-card-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--pv-text); }

    .pv-home-card-sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--pv-text-muted); }
    /* Leading type icon (monitor / phone / grid) */
    .pv-type-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--pv-text-muted); flex-shrink: 0; }
    /* Icon column with a full-height vertical divider (bleeds into card padding) */
    .pv-card-iconcol { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .pv-home-card .pv-card-iconcol { margin: -18px 0; padding-right: 16px; border-right: 1px solid var(--pv-panel-border); }
    .pv-home-card-arrow {
      flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--pv-text-muted); display: flex; align-items: center;
      transition: transform var(--pv-dur) var(--pv-ease), color var(--pv-dur) var(--pv-ease);

    .pv-home-card:hover .pv-home-card-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); color: var(--pv-text); }

      padding: 40px 20px; text-align: center;
      font-size: 15px; color: var(--pv-empty);
      border: 1px dashed var(--pv-panel-border); border-radius: 8px;
    }

    /* Prototype groups (nested prototypes): two columns, meta (left) + stacked children (right) */
    .pv-home-group {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
      border: 1px solid var(--pv-card-border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--pv-panel-bg);
      padding: 24px;
    }
    .pv-home-group:not(:last-child) { margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .pv-home-group-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
    .pv-home-group-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--pv-text); }
    .pv-home-group-date { font-size: 13px; color: var(--pv-text-muted); }
    .pv-home-group-desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--pv-text-muted); line-height: 1.55; margin: 4px 0 0; }
    .pv-home-tiles { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
    .pv-home-tile {
      min-width: 0;
      display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: stretch; gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--pv-card-border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--pv-surface);
      color: var(--pv-text);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: border-color var(--pv-dur) var(--pv-ease), background var(--pv-dur) var(--pv-ease);
    }
    .pv-home-tile .pv-type-icon { color: var(--pv-text-muted); }
    .pv-home-tile .pv-card-iconcol { margin: -14px 0; padding-right: 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--pv-panel-border); }
    .pv-home-tile .pv-home-card-main { justify-content: center; }
    .pv-home-tile:hover { border-color: #ffffff; background: var(--pv-border); }
    .pv-home-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pv-link); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .pv-home-tile-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--pv-text); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .pv-home-tile .pv-home-card-arrow { color: var(--pv-text-muted); display: flex; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .pv-home-tile:hover .pv-home-card-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); color: var(--pv-text); }
    @media (max-width: 560px) { .pv-home-group { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; } }

    /* Light theme: match the setup page surfaces exactly */
    [data-theme="light"] #pv-home { background: #F2f2f2; }
    [data-theme="light"] .pv-home-card { background: #ffffff; border-color: #999999; }
    [data-theme="light"] .pv-home-card:hover { border-color: #010101; background: #fafafa; }
    [data-theme="light"] .pv-home-empty { border-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }
    [data-theme="light"] .pv-home-group { background: #ffffff; border-color: #999999; }
    [data-theme="light"] .pv-home-tile { background: #fafafa; border-color: #999999; }
    [data-theme="light"] .pv-home-tile:hover { border-color: #010101; background: #f0f0f0; }

    /* Home FAB: matches the bottom-left tool FABs */
    #pv-home-fab {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--pv-panel-border);
      background: var(--pv-panel-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      color: var(--pv-text);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      transition: background 0.15s;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    #pv-home-fab:hover { background: var(--pv-surface); }

    /* Icon buttons in header */
    .pv-hbtn {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid var(--pv-border);
      background: var(--pv-surface);
      color: var(--pv-text);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .pv-hbtn:hover { background: rgba(128,128,128,0.2); }

    /* ── Main viewport ────────────────────────────────────────── */

      flex: 1;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

                  opacity 200ms ease-in-out;

    #pv-main.pv-fading { opacity: 0; }

      height: 100%;

    #pv-device-wrapper {

      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

      flex-shrink: 0;

    /* iOS frame */
    .pv-device-ios {
      width: 393px;
      height: 852px;
      border-radius: 54px;
      background: #0a0a0a;
      border: 10px solid #1c1c1e;
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 1px #3a3a3c,
        inset 0 0 0 1px #3a3a3c,
        0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,0.10),
        0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      overflow: hidden;

    /* Dynamic Island */
    .pv-device-ios::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 10px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 126px;
      height: 36px;
      background: #0a0a0a;
      border-radius: 20px;
      z-index: 10;
    }
    /* Volume buttons (left) */
    .pv-device-ios::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: -14px;
      top: 110px;
      width: 4px;
      height: 32px;
      background: #2c2c2e;
      border-radius: 2px 0 0 2px;
      box-shadow: 0 46px 0 #2c2c2e, 0 92px 0 #2c2c2e;

      position: absolute;
      right: -14px;
      top: 150px;
      width: 4px;
      height: 64px;
      background: #2c2c2e;
      border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;

      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border: none;

      height: 800px;

      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;

    /* Punch-hole camera */
    .pv-device-android::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 14px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 11px;
      height: 11px;
      background: #0a0a0a;
      border-radius: 50%;
      z-index: 10;

    /* Volume buttons (right) */
    .pv-device-android::after {
      content: '';

      right: -14px;

      box-shadow: none !important;

# Audit findings: Zimmermann Agentic Design Workflow (02-design)

**Scope confirmed:** 3 real spec files exist (`components/footer.md`, `components/navigation.md`, `templates/template-main-large-screen.md`; `specs/screens/` and `specs/flows/` contain only `.gitkeep`). 1 real prototype folder exists (`prototypes/templates/main-large-screen/`, with `index.html`, `intent.md`, `assets/`); `animations/`, `flows/`, `interactions/`, `tokens/` all contain only `.gitkeep`.

## Spec coverage gaps

- `02-design/specs/components/` — of the 8 library elements, only **footer** and **navigation** have spec files; **add-to-wishlist, button, icon, logo, nav-item, product-card** have no spec.
- `02-design/specs/screens/`, `02-design/specs/flows/` — both directories are entirely empty (no screen or flow specs exist at all).
- `02-design/specs/components/navigation.md` — its "Prototype" section states a prototype is "required for panel content layout, scroll-lock behaviour, and keyboard focus trap," but no interaction prototype exists anywhere on disk (`prototypes/interactions/` is empty).
- `02-design/specs/components/footer.md` and `templates/template-main-large-screen.md` — neither contains a prototype-link field/section, though the two-layer model calls for one in the design layer.

## Prototype/viewer registry mismatches

- `02-design/prototypes/templates/main-large-screen/intent.md` — its `spec: templates/template-main-large-screen.md` frontmatter resolves correctly to the existing spec file; no issue here.
- `02-design/prototypes/INDEX.md` — the registry table has a header row only, zero registered entries; `templates/main-large-screen` is not listed despite existing on disk with full content.
- `02-design/viewer/viewer.config.js` — the `variants` array is empty (`variants: []`); `templates/main-large-screen` is not listed here either.
- Net result: the only real prototype in the repo has never been registered via `/add-to-viewer` — it is invisible in both the registry and the client-facing viewer.

## Catalog/viewer wiring issues

- `02-design/catalog/index.html` (lines ~397–402) — `contractPaths` is hardcoded to `['../library/contract/ds-contract.js']` with `let prefix = 'ds'`. The real contract file is `02-design/library/contract/zimm-contract.js` (confirmed present, contains 8 valid component entries matching the 8 library elements), and `project.config.js` confirms `componentPrefix: "zimm"`. Since the catalog only ever attempts to import the nonexistent `ds-contract.js`, the import fails silently (caught by a try/catch) and the catalog renders its "No components in the contract yet" empty state even though a fully populated contract exists.
- `02-design/viewer/index.html` — no broken references found. It correctly loads `../../project.config.js` (resolves to the root config) and fetches `viewer.config.js` from its own directory at runtime; no stale "ds" prefix or hardcoded filename mismatches present.

**Summary:** the catalog is wired to a template placeholder (`ds-contract.js`) that was never updated to the project's actual prefix/contract filename, so it currently cannot display any of the 8 real components. The viewer itself is wired correctly but has nothing to show because `/add-to-viewer` was never run for the one existing prototype. Spec coverage is thin (2 of 8 components, no screens/flows) and one spec (navigation) calls for a prototype that doesn't exist.
